ageing.hint: How old the stock is on {day}, by material type.
ageing.hintLoading: How old the stock is, by material type.
ageing.failed: The stock ageing could not be read
ageing.emptyHint: No stock lies at the sites of this report.
ageing.chartLabel: Stock by age bucket per material type
ageing.captionShare: Each bar is one material type's quantity split by age; the line is its average age.
ageing.captionValue: Each bar is one material type's value ({currency}) split by age; the line is its average age.
ageing.leftOut: Not drawn (more than one unit, see the table): {types}.
ageing.noChart: No material type is in one unit: the table says the quantities.
ageing.definition: A lot is as old as its receipt (opening stock: its first move into stock); an article without lots is aged first in, first out. Quantities are added per unit, never across units.
ageing.customerOwned_one: {count} stock line is a customer's own material: counted, never valued.
ageing.customerOwned_other: {count} stock lines are customers' own material: counted, never valued.
ageing.drill: An article opens Stock searched by its code, Moves its movements. Stock takes no age or type filter yet.

leather.hint: Area received, cut, back as remnant, scrapped and on hand from {from} to {to}, by article and supplier lot.
leather.failed: The leather use could not be read
leather.empty: No leather moved or lay in stock in the period
leather.barsHint: {measure} per article, in m². A bar opens the article's hides.
leather.notAdding: A lot does not add up: start + received − cut − scrapped + other is not what is on hand. Check its moves.
leather.tableLabel: Leather use by article and supplier lot
leather.definition: Cut is what went to work orders less what came back whole or as a remnant. Other is opening stock, adjustments, counts, transfers between sites and returns to the supplier. A split lot's child lots count with their parent. Start + received − cut − scrapped + other = on hand.
leather.more_one: {count} more supplier lot is not listed.
leather.more_other: {count} more supplier lots are not listed.
leather.unvalued_one: {count} move of the period has no value yet.
leather.unvalued_other: {count} moves of the period have no value yet.
leather.severalUnits: The articles are in more than one unit: no total area is said.
leather.drill: An article or a lot opens its hides.
